tasks.label: Start CivicFlow Demo
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $py=Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { throw 'Missing .venv\Scripts\python.exe' }; Start-Process -FilePath $py -WorkingDirectory $root -ArgumentList '-m','uvicorn','apps.api.main:app','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','8000'; Start-Process -FilePath $py -WorkingDirectory $root -ArgumentList '-m','streamlit','run','apps\dashboard\app.py','--server.headless','true','--browser.gatherUsageStats','false'; Write-Host 'CivicFlow API and dashboard started.'

tasks.label: Stop CivicFlow Demo
args: $ports = 8000,8501; foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($c in $conns) { taskkill /PID $c.OwningProcess /F | Out-Null } }; Write-Host 'CivicFlow API and dashboard stopped.'
